messages.text: today felt kinda heavy... like the air in the house was just thick or something lol

I hear that heaviness, and using the metaphor of thick air really helps me understand your experience. It sounds like the atmosphere in your home mirrored some of the emotional weight you were carrying. I’m here to listen if you’d like to unpack what made today feel so dense.
nah it's fine, just one of those days y'know? everyone's kinda on edge but whatever lol

It’s totally understandable to want to brush it off when things feel tense. Walking around with everyone on edge takes a lot out of you, even if you don't say much. I’ll stay right here if you change your mind or need to offload later. Just try to be kind to yourself while navigating that thick air.
lol u sound like my mom’s friend who’s always telling me to “process my emotions” or whatever. no offense 😅

No offense taken at all, I really appreciate you telling me that straight up. I can definitely dial back the therapy speak if that feels too heavy for you. Sometimes just venting without the "processing" part is exactly what we need. Let's just keep it real and see where the conversation goes.
idk... part of me wants to talk about it, but part of me just wants to pretend it's normal and move on y'know? like, it *is* normal... just cause it's normal doesn't mean it doesn't suck tho

You hit on something really important there, because common doesn't mean easy. It makes perfect sense to feel pulled between talking it through and just enduring it. You don't owe anyone a deep dive if you're not ready. We can just acknowledge it sucks without needing to solve it.
my sister was super quiet all evening... which is weird for her. she usually bounces off the walls lol

That shift in her energy must have made the heavy atmosphere feel even more real. It sounds like the tension is affecting everyone in the house, not just you. Seeing someone close to you act out of character can really weigh on you. You don’t have to fix anything right now, just being aware of it is enough.
yeah... kinda scared she’s starting to notice stuff more. she’s only 12, y’know? shouldn’t have to walk around watching every little thing

It is really heavy to watch someone that young absorb so much tension. You are absolutely right that she shouldn’t have to walk around watching the room like that. It makes total sense that you feel protective over her right now. Seeing her shut down is a hard thing to deal with, even if you don't say anything about it.
like... why does he gotta make everything so damn tense? one wrong look and it’s like the whole house holds its breath. so tired of walking on eggshells lol (not really lol)

That sounds incredibly exhausting to deal with every single day. You're right that it's not really a joke when you're constantly bracing yourself. It's not fair that you and your sister have to manage his moods just to keep the peace. You deserve to feel safe and relaxed in your own space.
thanks... honestly it helps just hearing someone say it’s not normal. feels less like i’m overreacting y’know?

It makes a lot of sense that validation feels like a relief right now. You aren't overreacting to a situation that feels unsafe or tense. Your feelings are a normal response to an abnormal amount of pressure. I'm really glad you can trust your gut on that.
he just snapped at her tonight because dinner wasn’t his favorite. like... she made food, we all ate, but it wasn’t *that one thing* so suddenly everything’s wrong lol. classic

That really shows why the house feels so tense. It is incredibly unfair for your sister to get snapped at over dinner. She didn't do anything wrong to deserve that reaction. Your frustration is a valid response to seeing her treated that way.
lol it wasn’t my sister, it was my mom he went off on. but yeah… same energy. feels like we’re all just waiting for the next thing to go wrong

Thanks for clarifying that part, and it sounds like that tension impacts everyone equally. Living in a state of waiting for the next outburst is incredibly draining. It makes sense that the whole household feels like they’re holding their breath. I’m here whenever you need to vent about that pressure.
it just sucks seeing her take it y’know? she never even argues back. just gets quiet and does whatever he wants... like she’s scared or something

It's really painful to see someone you love feel that small around him. Noticing that fear in her silence shows how much you care about her safety. It makes sense that you feel helpless watching her take it without pushing back. You don't have to carry that worry alone right now.
i dunno... maybe i should say something more? but then i just stay quiet too. feels like i’m part of the problem sometimes lol (not really lol again)

You know it’s not true, but that guilt still feels heavy. Staying quiet is often just a way to keep things from getting worse in the moment. You aren't the problem when the tension comes from him. You're doing the best you can in a tough spot.
it’s just... so damn tiring y’know? always watching, always trying to keep my sister calm, making sure i don’t say the wrong thing... feels like i can’t just *breathe* sometimes

It makes total sense that you feel suffocated when you can't stop scanning the room for danger. You are carrying a huge load trying to protect your sister and keep the peace. No one should have to live like they can't take a breath in their own home. I'm glad you're sharing this weight with someone, even if it's just me right now.
yeah... honestly just saying it out loud helps. like, it’s still messed up, but i don’t feel totally alone with it right now. so... thanks

You're very welcome, and I'm glad you felt a bit less alone. It takes courage to name what's happening, especially when it feels scary. You don't have to carry this weight by yourself. I'm here whenever you need to check in again.
